The tithe percentage changes by founder word ALONE; rate_set versions track cost basis only. This number is law, not a parameter.

paid_claude.tier: PAID (founder tier-ladder ruling): the Claude-agents lane — A-metered at provider cost basis + the 10% tithe

cost_basis.note: Anthropic POSTED API pricing as the DISCLOSED REFERENCE BASIS while credits are unfunded (founder P3-GO option B). Receipts on this lane, when it opens, bill at these posted rates converted to A via the a_conversion_reference, plus THE TITHE (10%, separate line, founder law). Until the founder funds API credits the lane stays CLOSED — nothing bills.
